company.name: Tabadulat
company.shortDescription: Tabadulat is a Shariah-compliant brokerage platform offering access to global halal stocks with low trading fees.​
company.description: Tabadulat is a digital brokerage platform designed to provide Shariah-compliant investment opportunities. It enables users to trade over 60,000 halal-certified stocks across various global markets. The platform offers features such as fractional share investing, advanced analytics, and AI-powered insights, all while ensuring adherence to AAOIFI standards through supervision by independent scholars. Tabadulat emphasizes transparency with ultra-low trading fees starting from 0.25% and provides tools like a Zakat calculator and real-time compliance tracking. The service is currently in a pre-launch phase, inviting users to sign up for early access.​
